'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey, bro. My friendly competitors are poaching my customers. If they want to declare a trade war on me, then my answer has to be very serious. I found out how they transport their goods. They hire guys with big backpacks. Take care of those mules, will you?}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 35 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 15 targets that are using a 20+ container size [[backpack]]

==Rewards==
* +12,800 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 86,000 Roubles
** 90,300 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 98,900 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Gold skull ring]]
{{quote|Sick! That's how trade issues should always be dealt with.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets that are wearing a [[backpack]] with 20+ slots.
